integrity: One exact theorem; the 35-by-28 incidence matrix and a fully replayable 474-step integer Smith certificate plus a self-contained checker are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Geometric formal-bitangent incidence, with a chosen even theta characteristic and characteristic not two; not a Picard/Chow lattice, arithmetic Frobenius classification, or Galois-module determination.
title: The seven free defects and exact torsion of the even-Steiner bitangent lattice
